subject: Accelerated City Charter Review and Election Reforms
overview: The committee reviewed its governing agenda for the 2024-2025 term, voting to move the start of the city charter review process from June to April. The meeting also addressed ongoing oversight of the elections department and a proposal for various "pro-democracy" municipal reforms.

items.title: 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda
items.summary: The committee reviewed its areas of responsibility and approved the governing agenda as a working document to be placed on file.

items.title: City Charter Review Timeline
items.summary: Approved a motion to move the charter review start date from June to April to ensure the council can develop recommendations concurrently with the Mayor's appointed study committee.

items.title: Elections Process and Department Oversight
items.summary: Discussed the 2023 municipal election after-action report and noted concerns regarding current staffing levels in the elections office following the manager's resignation.

items.title: Pro-Democracy Reforms
items.summary: Reviewed a proposal to study ranked-choice voting, expanded voting eligibility, and the prioritization of a salary review for elected officials to potentially take effect in 2026.
